surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the coordination of the aminoalkoxide ligand to the zinc center, forming a bridging bond (μ-O) between two zinc atoms. The reaction proceeds through the adsorption of the precursor on the surface, followed by a water pulse to regenerate surface hydroxyl groups, leading to the formation of ZnO.
